The plugin sustainability working group meets on the napari community
calendar, at both *Atlantic* and *Pacific* times. Everyone is welcome:
plugin authors, users, and core developers.

- [Meeting schedule](https://napari.org/stable/community/meeting_schedule.html)
- [napari Zulip](https://napari.zulipchat.com/), for anything between meetings
- [The announcement on The Island Dispatch](https://napari.org/island-dispatch/blog/plugin-sustainability-initiative.html)
